verdict: NOT transferable: must not be applied outside the fitted cities. Cities without a reference air-quality surface ship traffic_exposure as a unitless traffic-pressure index only, never a concentration.

provenance.sources: Gent: ATMO-Street v7.2 2024 (IRCELINE/VMM/VITO, CC BY 4.0). Amsterdam: RIVM NSL 2024 (Atlas Leefomgeving).
provenance.caveat: Fitted to dispersion-model output, not measurements: inherits those models' biases. No meteorology, no point sources. Apply to a city outside the fitted set only within the transfer error reported above, and label output a modelled estimate, never compliance data.
